title: Spoofable LSASS/VSS semantic gates retain whole-host outage authority
recommendation: Retain role-aware argv negatives and fail-closed path/signature checks; keep ambiguous script semantics alert-only.

title: Ransomware isolation correlates unrelated entropy and rename evidence
recommendation: Retain directory-bound correlation and the cross-directory negative test.

title: Process contracts do not retain OS-handle/program-file identity
recommendation: Act through a retained verified OS process handle and bind path-wide firewall rules to canonical executable file identity with a bounded lease.

title: Secure quarantine cannot move watched user files across volumes
recommendation: Retain forced cross-volume success/mismatch tests and add a physical two-volume Windows acceptance gate.

title: Failed journal commit could leave a live orphan outside normal Undo
recommendation: Retain commit-failure, failed-compensation, circuit-breaker, exact orphan Undo, and irreversible-commit-failure regressions.

title: Local-AI posture advice could execute as elevated PowerShell
recommendation: Keep model output inert; any active remediation must be a registered typed operation with authorization, postcondition, receipt, and rollback.

title: Red Team cleanup deletes user files by filename prefix
recommendation: Retain the name-only lookalike regression; never reintroduce filename-only deletion authority.

title: Manual SOAR suspension bypassed Combat journal and remained resubmittable
recommendation: Retain forged-receipt, terminal-submission, queue-ID deduplication, saturation failure-receipt, and timeout regressions.

title: Top Talkers containment used a stale PID and non-enforcing blocklist
recommendation: Retain stale-PID, changed-executable, changed-peer, and malformed-address negative tests.

title: Deployment mirror accepted destructive arbitrary destinations
recommendation: Retain broad-path, overlap, unowned-sentinel, ownership-marker, preview, and wrong-confirmation negatives for Home and Backup.

title: Red STOP killed unrelated Python processes by broad ownership rules
recommendation: Retain exact approved launch positives and venv-pytest, Jupyter, arbitrary-script, substring, and PID-reuse negatives.
